verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents two background automations. Scheduled flags queue changes and apply them automatically at a set future time with no manual step. Release Pipelines move flags through stages automatically using triggers and actions, and can auto-generate change requests when promoting to production. Missing for 10: automations are limited to flag lifecycle and rollout (no general-purpose or agent-driven background workflows), trigger types and monitoring of automated runs are thinly documented, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
